name: Radio
description: Subject: antd@5.29.3 (pinned, examples/antd/PROVENANCE.md). CURATED seed for the antd P2 exam (code→canvas, held out) — props/axes only; anatomy is promoted from captured DOM truth. Every axis value is the library's own declared enum (antd spells them as `readonly [...]` tuples; seed-gen reads them once its declaration lookup ignores directory case — W1, examples/antd/RECON.md §4). THE PSEUDO-DOT CASE: the dot is `.ant-radio-inner::after` revealed by `transform: scale()` — the pseudo-decor v1 grammar carries translate + orthonormal rotate only, so the checked dot is expected to land REFUSED BY NAME (pseudo-decor-outside-grammar), never silent. `checked` is a variant axis (unchecked|checked), controlled with a no-op onChange. NAMED OUT: Radio.Button (dotted importName is not in the harness import grammar — W8), Radio.Group.
